verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl lə·’ā·sāp̄ ha·’ă·zî·nāh ‘am·mî tō·w·rā·ṯî haṭ·ṭū ’ā·zə·nə·ḵem lə·’im·rê- p̄î
verses.literal: A Maskil of Asaph Give ear O my people to my instruction listen . . . to the words of my mouth
verses.literalPt: Escutai, povo meu, a minha lei; inclinai os vossos ouvidos às palavras da minha boca.

verses.original: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי־ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·tə·ḥāh ḇə·mā·šāl pî ’ab·bî·‘āh ḥî·ḏō·wṯ min·nî- qe·ḏem
verses.literal: I will open my mouth in parables I will utter things hidden from the beginning
verses.literalPt: Abrirei numa parábola a minha boca, proferirei enigmas tirados dos tempos antigos.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer šā·maʿ·nû wan·nê·ḏā·‘êm wa·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū sip·pə·rū- lā·nū
verses.literal: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us
verses.literalPt: As coisas que temos ouvido e sabido e que nossos pais nos têm contado,

verses.original: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד׀ מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: lō nə·ḵa·ḥêḏ mib·bə·nê·hem lə·ḏō·wr ’a·ḥă·rō·wn mə·sap·pə·rîm tə·hil·lō·wṯ Yah·weh we·‘ĕ·zū·zōw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: We will not hide them from their children but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might and the wonders He has performed
verses.literalPt: não as ocultaremos a seus filhos, narrando às gerações vindouras os louvores de Jeová, e a sua força, e as maravilhas que ele tem obrado.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת׀ בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem ‘ê·ḏūṯ bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ṯō·w·rāh śām bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū lə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ām liḇ·nê·hem
verses.literal: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children
verses.literalPt: Porque ele estabeleceu um testemunho em Jacó e instituiu uma lei em Israel, as quais coisas mandou a nossos pais que as fizessem conhecer a seus filhos,

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ׀ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yê·ḏə·‘ū dō·wr ’a·ḥă·rō·wn bā·nîm yiw·wā·lê·ḏū yā·qu·mū wî·sap·pə·rū liḇ·nê·hem
verses.literal: that the coming generation would know them even children yet to be born to arise and tell their own children
verses.literalPt: para que a soubesse a geração vindoura, a saber, os filhos que houvessem de nascer, os quais se levantassem e as contassem a seus filhos;

verses.original: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי־ אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·śî·mū ḇê·lō·hîm kis·lām wə·lō yiš·kə·ḥū ma·‘al·lê- ’êl ū·miṣ·wō·ṯāw yin·ṣō·rū
verses.literal: that they should put their confidence in God not forgetting His works but keeping His commandments
verses.literalPt: a fim de que pusessem a sua confiança em Deus e não se esquecessem das obras de Deus, mas guardassem os seus mandamentos;

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ׀ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא־ הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־ נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת־ אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yih·yū ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām dō·wr sō·w·rêr ū·mō·reh dō·wr lō- hê·ḵîn lib·bōw wə·lō- ne·’em·nāh ’eṯ- ’êl rū·ḥōw
verses.literal: Then they will not be like their fathers a stubborn and rebellious generation whose heart was not loyal whose spirit was not faithful to God
verses.literalPt: e que não fossem como seus pais, geração contumaz e rebelde; geração que não regeu bem o coração, e cujo espírito não foi fiel a Deus.

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי־ אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי־ קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim nō·wō·šə·qê rō·w·mê- qā·šeṯ hā·p̄ə·ḵū bə·yō·wm qə·rāḇ
verses.literal: The archers . . . . . . of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Efraim, armados de arcos, bateram em retirada no dia da batalha.

verses.original: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lō šā·mə·rû bə·rîṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯōw mê·’ă·nū lā·le·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law
verses.literalPt: Não guardaram a aliança de Deus e recusaram andar na sua lei;

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kə·ḥū ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯāw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw ’ă·šer her·’ām
verses.literal: They forgot what He had done the wonders He had shown them
verses.literalPt: esqueceram-se dos seus feitos e das obras maravilhosas que ele lhes tinha mostrado.

verses.original: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה־ צֹֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: ne·ḡeḏ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ‘ā·śāh p̄e·le bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim śə·ḏêh- ṣō·‘an
verses.literal: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt in the region of Zoan
verses.literalPt: Maravilhas fez ele à vista de seus pais, na terra do Egito, no campo de Zoã.

verses.original: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב־ מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ־ נֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bā·qa‘ yām way·ya·‘ă·ḇî·rêm way·yaṣ·ṣeḇ- ma·yim kə·mōw- nêḏ
verses.literal: He split the sea and brought them through He set the waters upright like a wall
verses.literalPt: Dividiu o mar e fê-los passar; fez parar as águas como um montão.

verses.original: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם וְכָל־ הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה בְּא֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yan·ḥêm be·‘ā·nān yō·w·mām wə·ḵāl hal·lay·lāh bə·’ō·wr ’êš
verses.literal: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night
verses.literalPt: Também os guiou, de dia, por uma nuvem e, durante a noite toda, por um clarão de fogo.

verses.original: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמ֥וֹת רַבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḇaq·qa‘ ṣu·rîm bam·miḏ·bār way·yašq kiṯ·hō·mō·wṯ rab·bāh
verses.literal: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas
verses.literalPt: Fendeu rochas no deserto e deu-lhes a beber abundantemente como de abismos.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע וַיּ֖וֹרֶד כַּנְּהָר֣וֹת מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi nō·wz·lîm mis·sā·la‘ way·yō·w·reḏ kan·nə·hā·rō·wṯ mā·yim
verses.literal: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers
verses.literalPt: Fez sair da penha torrentes e fez correr águas como rios.

verses.original: וַיּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַחֲטֹא־ ל֑וֹ לַֽמְר֥וֹת עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּצִּיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·sî·p̄ū ‘ō·wḏ la·ḥă·ṭō- lōw lam·rō·wṯ ‘el·yō·wn baṣ·ṣî·yāh
verses.literal: But they continued . . . to sin against Him rebelling in the desert against the Most High
verses.literalPt: Todavia, ainda prosseguiram em pecar contra ele, rebelando-se contra o Altíssimo no deserto.

verses.original: וַיְנַסּוּ־ אֵ֥ל בִּלְבָבָ֑ם לִֽשְׁאָל־ אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·nas·sū- ’êl bil·ḇā·ḇām liš·’āl- ’ō·ḵel lə·nap̄·šām
verses.literal: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved
verses.literalPt: Tentaram a Deus nos seus corações, pedindo comida segundo o seu apetite.

verses.original: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bə·rū bê·lō·hîm ’ā·mə·rū hă·yū·ḵal ’êl la·‘ă·rōḵ šul·ḥān bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: They spoke against God saying Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Falaram contra Deus, disseram: Porventura, pode Deus preparar uma mesa no deserto?

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה־ צ֨וּר׀ וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲגַם־ לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם־ יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְעַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hên hik·kāh- ṣūr way·yā·zū·ḇū ma·yim ū·nə·ḥā·lîm yiš·ṭō·p̄ū hă·ḡam- le·ḥem yū·ḵal têṯ ’im- yā·ḵîn šə·’êr lə·‘am·mōw
verses.literal: When He struck the rock water gushed out and torrents raged But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat
verses.literalPt: Eis que feriu a rocha, e brotaram águas, e torrentes trasbordaram. Pode ele também dar pão? Acaso, fornecerá carne ao seu povo?

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן׀ שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם־ אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šā·ma‘ Yah·weh way·yiṯ·‘ab·bār wə·’êš niś·śə·qāh ḇə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ḡam- ’ap̄ ‘ā·lāh ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath so a fire was kindled against Jacob and His anger flared against Israel
verses.literalPt: Portanto, Jeová, ao ouvir isso, ficou irado. Acendeu-se fogo contra Jacó, também se levantou ira contra Israel;

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō he·’ĕ·mî·nū bê·lō·hîm wə·lō ḇā·ṭə·ḥū bî·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: because they did not believe God . . . or rely on His salvation
verses.literalPt: porque não creram em Deus e não confiaram na sua salvação.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw šə·ḥā·qîm mim·mā·‘al wə·ḏal·ṯê šā·ma·yim pā·ṯāḥ
verses.literal: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens
verses.literalPt: Contudo, ordenou às nuvens lá em cima e abriu as portas do céu;

verses.original: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וּדְגַן־ שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yam·ṭêr ‘ă·lê·hem mān le·’ĕ·ḵōl ū·ḏə·ḡa·nō·šā- šā·ma·yim nā·ṯan lā·mōw
verses.literal: He rained down manna for them to eat He gave them grain from heaven
verses.literalPt: sobre eles fez chover maná para comer e deu-lhes do trigo do céu.

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם לָשֹֽׂבַע׃
verses.transliteration: le·ḥem ’ab·bî·rîm ’ā·ḵal ’îš ṣê·ḏāh šā·laḥ lā·hem lā·śō·ḇa‘
verses.literal: Man ate the bread of angels He sent them food in abundance
verses.literalPt: Comeu cada qual o pão dos poderosos; ele lhes enviou comida a fartar.

verses.original: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג בְּעֻזּ֣וֹ תֵימָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: yas·sa‘ qā·ḏîm baš·šā·mā·yim way·na·hêḡ bə·‘uz·zōw ṯê·mān
verses.literal: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might
verses.literalPt: Fez soprar no céu o vento do Oriente e, pelo seu poder, conduziu o vento sul.

verses.original: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽכְח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים ע֣וֹף כָּנָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yam·ṭêr ‘ă·lê·hem ke·‘ā·p̄ār šə·’êr ū·ḵə·ḥō·wl yam·mîm ‘ō·wp̄ kā·nāp̄
verses.literal: He rained meat on them like dust and winged birds like the sand of the sea
verses.literalPt: Sobre eles fez também chover carne como poeira e aves de asas, como areia dos mares;

verses.original: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yap·pêl bə·qe·reḇ ma·ḥă·nê·hū sā·ḇîḇ lə·miš·kə·nō·ṯāw
verses.literal: He felled them in the midst of their camp all around their dwellings
verses.literalPt: fê-las cair no meio do arraial deles, ao redor das suas habitações.

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝תַֽאֲוָתָ֗ם יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiś·bə·‘ū mə·’ōḏ wə·ṯa·’ă·wā·ṯām yā·ḇi lā·hem
verses.literal: So they ate and were well filled for He gave them what they craved
verses.literalPt: Assim, eles comeram e se fartaram bem, pois ele lhes trouxe o que cobiçavam.

verses.original: לֹא־ זָר֥וּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם ע֝֗וֹד אָכְלָ֥ם בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- zā·rū mit·ta·’ă·wā·ṯām ‘ō·wḏ ’ā·ḵə·lām bə·p̄î·hem
verses.literal: Yet before they had filled their desire with the food still in their mouths
verses.literalPt: Não se apartavam da sua cobiça. Ainda a comida lhes estava na boca,

verses.original: וְאַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ā·lāh ḇā·hem way·ya·hă·rōḡ bə·miš·man·nê·hem ū·ḇa·ḥū·rê yiś·rā·’êl hiḵ·rî·a‘
verses.literal: God’s anger flared against them and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel
verses.literalPt: quando a ira de Deus se levantou contra eles, matou dos mais vigorosos deles e prostrou os mancebos de Israel.

verses.original: בְּכָל־ זֹ֭את חָֽטְאוּ־ ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־ הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl zōṯ ḥā·ṭə·’ū- ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō- he·’ĕ·mî·nū bə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: In spite of all this they kept on sinning despite His wonderful works they did not believe
verses.literalPt: Apesar de tudo isso continuaram a pecar e não creram nas suas maravilhas.

verses.original: וַיְכַל־ בַּהֶ֥בֶל יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝שְׁנוֹתָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal- ba·he·ḇel yə·mê·hem ū·šə·nō·w·ṯām bab·be·hā·lāh
verses.literal: So He ended their days in futility and their years in sudden terror
verses.literalPt: Por isso, acabou com os dias deles em um sopro, e os anos, num terror repentino.

verses.original: אִם־ הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- hă·rā·ḡām ū·ḏə·rā·šū·hū wə·šā·ḇū wə·ši·ḥă·rū- ’êl
verses.literal: When He slew them they would seek Him they repented and searched for God
verses.literalPt: Quando ele os fazia morrer, então, o buscavam; voltavam e, de manhã, procuravam a Deus.

verses.original: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kə·rū kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣū·rām wə·’êl ‘el·yō·wn gō·’ă·lām
verses.literal: And they remembered that God was their Rock that God Most High was their Redeemer
verses.literalPt: Lembraram-se de que Deus era a sua Rocha, e o Deus Altíssimo, o seu Redentor.

verses.original: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בִלְשׁוֹנָ֗ם יְכַזְּבוּ־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·p̄at·tū·hū bə·p̄î·hem ū·ḇil·šō·w·nām yə·ḵaz·zə·ḇū- lōw
verses.literal: But they deceived Him with their mouths and lied to Him with their tongues
verses.literalPt: Eles, porém, o lisonjeavam com a sua boca e, com a sua língua, lhe mentiam.

verses.original: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא־ נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lib·bām lō- nā·ḵō·wn ‘im·mōw wə·lō ne·’em·nū biḇ·rî·ṯōw
verses.literal: Their hearts were disloyal . . . to Him and they were unfaithful . . . to His covenant
verses.literalPt: Pois o coração deles não era constante para com ele, nem eram fiéis na sua aliança.

verses.original: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־ יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יָ֝עִיר כָּל־ חֲמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ra·ḥūm yə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·wōn wə·lō- yaš·ḥîṯ wə·hir·bāh lə·hā·šîḇ ’ap·pōw wə·lō- yā·‘îr kāl- ḥă·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: And yet He was compassionate He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them He often restrained His anger . . . and did not unleash His full wrath
verses.literalPt: Mas ele é cheio de compaixão, revela a iniquidade e não destrói; muitas vezes, desvia a sua ira e não dá largas a todo o seu furor.

verses.original: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּי־ בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kōr kî- ḇā·śār hêm·māh rū·aḥ hō·w·lêḵ wə·lō yā·šūḇ
verses.literal: He remembered that they were but flesh a passing breeze that does not return
verses.literalPt: Lembrava-se de que eles eram carne, um vento que passa e não volta mais.

verses.original: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kam·māh yam·rū·hū ḇam·miḏ·bār ya·‘ă·ṣî·ḇū·hū bî·šî·mō·wn
verses.literal: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert
verses.literalPt: Quantas vezes se rebelaram contra ele no deserto e o agravaram no ermo!

verses.original: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְווּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šū·ḇū way·nas·sū ’êl ū·qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl hiṯ·wū
verses.literal: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel
verses.literalPt: Eles voltaram, e tentaram a Deus, e provocaram o Santo de Israel.

verses.original: לֹא־ זָכְר֥וּ אֶת־ יָד֑וֹ י֝֗וֹם אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ פָּדָ֥ם מִנִּי־ צָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- zā·ḵə·rū ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw yō·wm ’ăšer- pā·ḏām min·nî- ṣār
verses.literal: They did not remember His power the day He redeemed them from the adversary
verses.literalPt: Não se lembraram do poder dele, nem do dia em que os remiu do adversário;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣ם בְּ֭מִצְרַיִם אֹֽתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מוֹפְתָ֗יו בִּשְׂדֵה־ צֹֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- śām bə·miṣ·ra·yim ’ō·ṯō·w·ṯāw ū·mō·wp̄·ṯāw biś·ḏêh- ṣō·‘an
verses.literal: when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan
verses.literalPt: de como fez no Egito os seus sinais e os seus prodígios, no campo de Zoã,

verses.original: וַיַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ לְ֭דָם יְאֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹזְלֵיהֶ֗ם בַּל־ יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·p̄ōḵ lə·ḏām yə·’ō·rê·hem wə·nō·zə·lê·hem bal- yiš·tā·yūn
verses.literal: He turned their rivers to blood and from their streams they could not drink
verses.literalPt: convertendo em sangue os rios deles e as suas correntes, para que delas não bebessem.

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּהֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וּ֝צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·laḥ bā·hem ‘ā·rōḇ way·yō·ḵə·lêm ū·ṣə·p̄ar·dê·a‘ wat·taš·ḥî·ṯêm
verses.literal: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them and frogs that devastated them
verses.literalPt: Enviou-lhes enxames de moscas, que os devoraram, e rãs, que os destruíram.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לֶחָסִ֣יל יְבוּלָ֑ם וִֽ֝יגִיעָ֗ם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên le·ḥā·sîl yə·ḇū·lām wî·ḡî·‘ām lā·’ar·beh
verses.literal: He gave their crops to the grasshopper the fruit of their labor to the locust
verses.literalPt: Entregou às lagartas as novidades deles e aos gafanhotos, os frutos do seu trabalho.

verses.original: יַהֲרֹ֣ג בַּבָּרָ֣ד גַּפְנָ֑ם וְ֝שִׁקְמוֹתָ֗ם בַּֽחֲנָמַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ya·hă·rōḡ bab·bā·rāḏ gap̄·nām wə·šiq·mō·w·ṯām ba·ḥă·nā·mal
verses.literal: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet
verses.literalPt: Destruiu com saraiva as vinhas deles e os seus sicômoros, com chuva de pedra.

verses.original: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַבָּרָ֣ד בְּעִירָ֑ם וּ֝מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·gêr lab·bā·rāḏ bə·‘î·rām ū·miq·nê·hem lā·rə·šā·p̄îm
verses.literal: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning
verses.literalPt: Entregou à saraiva o gado deles e aos raios, os seus rebanhos.

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּח־ בָּ֨ם׀ חֲר֬וֹן אַפּ֗וֹ עֶבְרָ֣ה וָזַ֣עַם וְצָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת מַלְאֲכֵ֥י רָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·laḥ- bām ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw ‘eḇ·rāh wā·za·‘am wə·ṣā·rāh miš·la·ḥaṯ mal·’ă·ḵê rā·‘îm
verses.literal: He unleashed His fury . . . against them wrath indignation and calamity a band of destroying angels
verses.literalPt: Sobre eles lançou o furor da sua ira, cólera, indignação e calamidade — tropel de anjos importadores de males.

verses.original: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְאַ֫פּ֥וֹ לֹא־ חָשַׂ֣ךְ מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם לַדֶּ֥בֶר הִסְגִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: yə·p̄al·lês nā·ṯîḇ lə·’ap·pōw lō- ḥā·śaḵ mim·mā·weṯ nap̄·šām wə·ḥay·yā·ṯām lad·de·ḇer his·gîr
verses.literal: He cleared a path for His anger He did not spare them from death but delivered their lives to the plague
verses.literalPt: Deu livre curso à sua ira; não poupou da morte a alma deles, mas a sua vida a entregou à pestilência.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־ בְּכ֣וֹר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית א֝וֹנִ֗ים בְּאָהֳלֵי־ חָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·miṣ·rā·yim rê·šîṯ ’ō·w·nîm bə·’ā·ho·lê- ḥām
verses.literal: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt the virility in the tents of Ham
verses.literalPt: Feriu todos os primogênitos no Egito, primícias da força deles nas tendas de Cam.

verses.original: וַיַּסַּ֣ע כַּצֹּ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֥ם כַּ֝עֵ֗דֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·sa‘ kaṣ·ṣōn ‘am·mōw way·na·hă·ḡêm ka·‘ê·ḏer bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: He led out His people . . . like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Mas ele fez partir o seu povo como ovelhas e guiou-os no deserto como um rebanho.

verses.original: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם לָ֭בֶטַח וְלֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְאֶת־ א֝וֹיְבֵיהֶ֗ם כִּסָּ֥ה הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yan·ḥêm lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·lō p̄ā·ḥā·ḏū wə·’eṯ- ’ō·wy·ḇê·hem kis·sāh hay·yām
verses.literal: He led them safely so they did not fear but the sea engulfed their enemies
verses.literalPt: Conduziu-os em segurança, de modo que não tiveram medo; mas aos seus inimigos, o mar os submergiu.

verses.original: וַ֭יְבִיאֵם אֶל־ גְּב֣וּל קָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַר־ זֶ֝֗ה קָנְתָ֥ה יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇî·’êm ’el- gə·ḇūl qā·ḏə·šōw har- zeh qā·nə·ṯāh yə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: He brought them to His holy land to the mountain . . . His right hand had acquired
verses.literalPt: Levou-os à sua santa fronteira, a região montanhosa que a sua destra adquirira.

verses.original: וַיְגָ֤רֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֨ם׀ גּוֹיִ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḡā·reš mip·pə·nê·hem gō·w·yim way·yap·pî·lêm bə·ḥe·ḇel na·ḥă·lāh way·yaš·kên bə·’ā·ho·lê·hem šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: He drove out nations before them and apportioned . . . their inheritance He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents
verses.literalPt: Expulsou as nações de diante deles e fez que elas lhes caíssem em herança e que as tribos de Israel habitassem nas tendas delas.

verses.original: וַיְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭יַּמְרוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן וְ֝עֵדוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·nas·sū way·yam·rū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘el·yō·wn wə·‘ê·ḏō·w·ṯāw lō šā·mā·rū
verses.literal: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High for they did not keep His decrees
verses.literalPt: Contudo, tentaram, e resistiram ao Deus Altíssimo, e não guardaram os seus testemunhos.

verses.original: וַיִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֑ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sō·ḡū way·yiḇ·gə·ḏū ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām neh·pə·ḵū kə·qe·šeṯ rə·mî·yāh
verses.literal: They turned back and were faithless like their fathers twisted like a faulty bow
verses.literalPt: Mas voltaram para trás, e se houveram traiçoeiramente como seus pais, e desviaram-se como um arco enganoso.

verses.original: וַיַּכְעִיס֥וּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָ֑ם וּ֝בִפְסִילֵיהֶ֗ם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·‘î·sū·hū bə·ḇā·mō·w·ṯām ū·ḇip̄·sî·lê·hem yaq·nî·’ū·hū
verses.literal: They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols
verses.literalPt: Pois o provocaram à ira com os seus altos e o incitaram a zelos com as suas imagens de escultura.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַיִּמְאַ֥ס מְ֝אֹ֗ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiṯ·‘ab·bār way·yim·’as mə·’ōḏ bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: On hearing it God was furious and rejected Israel completely
verses.literalPt: Quando Deus ouviu isso, ficou indignado e sobremaneira abominou a Israel;

verses.transliteration: way·yiṭ·ṭōš miš·kan ši·lōw ’ō·hel šik·kên bā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh the tent He had pitched among men
verses.literalPt: de sorte que abandonou o tabernáculo de Siló, a tenda que estabeleceu entre os homens,

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לַשְּׁבִ֣י עֻזּ֑וֹ וְֽתִפְאַרְתּ֥וֹ בְיַד־ צָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên laš·šə·ḇî ‘uz·zōw wə·ṯip̄·’ar·tōw ḇə·yaḏ- ṣār
verses.literal: He delivered His strength to captivity and His splendor to the hand of the adversary
verses.literalPt: dando ao cativeiro a sua força e às mãos do adversário, a sua glória.

verses.original: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַחֶ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְנַחֲלָת֗וֹ הִתְעַבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·gêr la·ḥe·reḇ ‘am·mōw ū·ḇə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw hiṯ·‘ab·bār
verses.literal: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage
verses.literalPt: Entregou à espada o seu povo e rompeu em cólera contra a sua herança.

verses.original: בַּחוּרָ֥יו אָֽכְלָה־ אֵ֑שׁ וּ֝בְתוּלֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥū·rāw ’ā·ḵə·lāh- ’êš ū·ḇə·ṯū·lō·ṯāw lō hūl·lā·lū
verses.literal: Fire consumed His young men and their maidens were left without wedding songs
verses.literalPt: Aos mancebos deles, devorou-os o fogo, e as suas donzelas não foram festejadas com canto nupcial.

verses.original: כֹּ֭הֲנָיו בַּחֶ֣רֶב נָפָ֑לוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: kō·hă·nāw ba·ḥe·reḇ nā·p̄ā·lū wə·’al·mə·nō·ṯāw lō ṯiḇ·ke·nāh
verses.literal: His priests fell by the sword but their widows could not lament
verses.literalPt: Os seus sacerdotes caíram à espada, e as suas viúvas não fizeram pranto.

verses.original: וַיִּקַ֖ץ כְּיָשֵׁ֥ן׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר מִתְרוֹנֵ֥ן מִיָּֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·qaṣ kə·yā·šên ’ă·ḏō·nāy kə·ḡib·bō·wr miṯ·rō·w·nên mî·yā·yin
verses.literal: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep like a mighty warrior overcome by wine
verses.literalPt: Então, o Senhor despertou, como quem acaba de dormir, como um valente que brada, excitado pelo vinho.

verses.original: וַיַּךְ־ צָרָ֥יו אָח֑וֹר חֶרְפַּ֥ת ע֝וֹלָ֗ם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ- ṣā·rāw ’ā·ḥō·wr ḥer·paṯ ‘ō·w·lām nā·ṯan lā·mōw
verses.literal: He beat back His foes He put them to . . . everlasting shame
verses.literalPt: Fez recuar a golpes os seus adversários, infligiu-lhes eterna ignomínia.

verses.original: וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·’as bə·’ō·hel yō·w·sêp̄ ū·ḇə·šê·ḇeṭ ’ep̄·ra·yim lō ḇā·ḥār
verses.literal: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused . . . the tribe of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: Demais, rejeitou a tenda de José e não escolheu a tribo de Efraim;

verses.original: וַ֭יִּבְחַר אֶת־ שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת־ הַ֥ר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·ḥar ’eṯ- šê·ḇeṭ yə·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ- har ṣî·yō·wn ’ă·šer ’ā·hêḇ
verses.literal: But He chose the tribe of Judah Mount Zion which He loved
verses.literalPt: mas elegeu a tribo de Judá, o monte Sião que ele amou.

verses.original: וַיִּ֣בֶן כְּמוֹ־ רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשׁ֑וֹ כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen kə·mōw- rā·mîm miq·dā·šōw kə·’e·reṣ yə·sā·ḏāh lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He built His sanctuary like the heights like the earth He has established forever
verses.literalPt: Edificou o seu santuário como os lugares elevados, como a terra que para sempre fundou.

verses.original: וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·ḥar bə·ḏā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dōw way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū mim·miḵ·lə·’ōṯ ṣōn
verses.literal: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds . . .
verses.literalPt: Escolheu a Davi, seu servo, e o tirou dos currais das ovelhas.

verses.original: מֵאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱ֫בִיא֥וֹ לִ֭רְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’a·ḥar ‘ā·lō·wṯ hĕ·ḇî·’ōw lir·‘ō·wṯ bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘am·mōw ū·ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob of Israel His inheritance
verses.literalPt: Tirou-o de andar atrás de ovelhas e suas crias, para apascentar a Jacó, seu povo, e a Israel, sua herança.

verses.original: וַ֭יִּרְעֵם כְּתֹ֣ם לְבָב֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנ֖וֹת כַּפָּ֣יו יַנְחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·‘êm kə·ṯōm lə·ḇā·ḇōw ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nō·wṯ kap·pāw yan·ḥêm
verses.literal: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands
verses.literalPt: Assim, ele os apascentou segundo a integridade do seu coração e os guiou com a perícia das suas mãos.
